settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage application preferences, notifications, image servers, and authorization rules.

items.linkPreview: Open links in a preview window
items.blockedImagePreview: Open blocked images in a preview window
items.lunaHandshake: Announce Luna to other Luna clients
items.showEvents: Show join, part, quit, nick and kick lines
items.groupEvents: Fold series of events into one line
items.scrollOnReturn: Scroll to new messages on return and when opening a chat

appearance.windowMaterialDesc: Applied to the window background behind the translucent surfaces.
appearance.acrylic: Acrylic (blur of the desktop behind the window)
appearance.displayNameDesc: Select default member name format across chat messages, user lists, and hover cards.
appearance.groupByRoleDesc: Split the channel user list into owners, operators, voiced, users and away.
appearance.dateFormatDesc: Choose how timestamps are displayed in chat messages.
appearance.sortDmRecentDesc: Always keep the conversation with the latest message at the top. Turn off to use the order set below.
appearance.sortDmUnreadDesc: Move private messages with unread messages to the top of the list.
appearance.sortDmDesc: Choose base sorting order for active private messages.
appearance.statusIndicatorDesc: Configure when the connection status badge (IRC, resource server, internet) is displayed.

layout.modernDesc: Avatars, name above the text, grouped messages.
layout.ircDesc: One dense line per message: [time] <nick> text.

appearance.unicodeStandard: Unicode Technical Standard #35 date format patterns

chat.formattingPreviewDesc: Show a live preview of bold, italic, underline, and strikethrough while composing messages.
chat.scrollOnReturn: Scroll to new messages on return and when opening a chat
chat.scrollOnReturnDesc: When you come back to the app or open a chat that has unread messages, jump straight to the first one.
chat.jumbojiDesc: Adjust size for emoji-only messages. Set to 0 to disable enlarged emojis and display standard text font size.
chat.linkPreview: Open links in a preview window
chat.linkPreviewDesc: Clicking a link opens it in a separate in-app window instead of the default browser. Desktop only.
chat.blockedImagePreview: Open blocked images in a preview window
chat.blockedImagePreviewDesc: When an image can't be loaded (e.g. blocked by a Cloudflare check), "View in browser" opens it in the in-app window. Desktop only.
chat.lunaHandshake: Announce Luna to other Luna clients
chat.lunaHandshakeDesc: Sends a short hidden message with your Luna version when you join a channel and notes who answers, so Luna-only features (reactions, avatars) are only sent where someone can use them. Other IRC clients show nothing in chat. Shows "Luna <version>" on a user profile card. Turn off to stay invisible.
chat.showEventDesc: Hidden lines stay in the log; this only changes what the chat shows.
chat.eventsTitle: Join, part, quit, nick and kick lines
chat.groupEventsDesc: Three or more events in a row become a single line such as "alice, bob joined · carol left".
chat.enableHighlightsDesc: Messages that contain your own words (below), besides your nick, are highlighted and notify you like a mention.
chat.ignoreListDesc: One per line. Messages from these users are dropped before they are shown, logged or counted as unread. Use a nick, nick!user@host, user@host or @host; * and ? work as wildcards. Also: /ignore <mask> and /unignore <mask>.
chat.warnExternalLinksDesc: Shows the address and lets you copy it or cancel before a link from the chat opens. You can trust a site there to skip the question for it.
chat.groupEvents: Fold series of events into one line
chat.sendTypingDesc: Lets others in the chat see "is typing..." while you write. Needs a server with IRCv3 client tags (message-tags); on other servers nothing is sent. You always see when others are typing.
chat.confirmLeaveDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when leaving a channel.
chat.slashAutocompleteDesc: Show suggestions popup when typing / in chat.
chat.replyFormatDesc: Choose how replies are sent to servers. Auto uses modern IRCv3 tags if supported and falls back to legacy inline quoting.
chat.nickCompletionDesc: Choose how member nicknames are formatted when completed using the Tab suggestions menu.
chat.motdDesc: Choose when to automatically display server MOTD popups upon connecting or joining.
chat.interactiveCommandsDesc: Choosing /mode, /op, /deop, /voice or /devoice from the suggestions opens a small panel instead of inserting text.

experimental.intro: Features that only work between Luna clients and may change or be removed. Everything stays off unless you turn it on; other clients are unaffected.
experimental.avatarsDesc: Shows small avatars of Luna users and shares yours. Images are 32x32, travel as short CTCP messages in chunks and are stored only on each client, never uploaded to a server. Also enable it per server in the server settings (Behavior).
experimental.forwardDesc: Adds "Forward to channel" to the right-click menu of a message: pick a channel on the same server and the message is sent there with its author and source channel.

previews.linkPreviewsDesc: Show media previews (images, videos, YouTube, websites) in chat.
previews.collapseImagesDesc: Automatically collapse image previews in chat messages into compact expandable cards.
previews.motdMediaDesc: Show rich media embeds (images, videos, YouTube) in Message of the Day dialogs.
previews.webMetadataDesc: Use API to fetch title, description, and thumbnails for web pages. Direct images don't use the API.
previews.apiUrlDesc: Open-Source metadata API URL for fetching web page previews.
previews.blockAds: Block ads, trackers and cookie notices in link previews
previews.blockAdsDesc: Uses EasyList filters, downloaded once a week. Network blocking works on Windows; hiding elements works everywhere.

uploads.providerDesc: Select a service for uploading images pasted from clipboard or files. A direct link will be sent to the IRC chat.
uploads.litterboxDesc: Images expire automatically after the selected duration. They remain public until deleted.

auth.title: Image read authorization (URL headers)
auth.desc: Define HTTP headers (e.g., tokens) to be sent when fetching and previewing images from specified URL prefixes.

updates.title: Software updates
updates.desc: Select automatic check and download preferences for new releases.
updates.checkOnStart: Check for new versions on app startup and notify when update is ready.
updates.askDialog: Show a dialog when a new version is detected with options: "Update now" or "Remind me later".
updates.manual: Application will not check for updates automatically on startup.
updates.channelDesc: Choose where updates come from. After switching, the next check offers that channel's latest build.
updates.customEndpoint: Must be a valid HTTP(S) endpoint returning a Tauri update JSON manifest.
updates.publicKey: Minisign public key the releases are signed with. Leave empty to use the official key.

notifications.globalDesc: Configure default audio alerts, desktop popups, and taskbar indicators. You can override these per server or channel.
notifications.serverDesc: Customize notification rules for messages on this server. Select "Default" to inherit from client settings.
notifications.channelDesc: Customize notification rules for this chat. Select "Default" to inherit from parent settings.

cat.authSub: URL header rules for private hosts

search.scrollOnReturn: Scroll to new messages on return and when opening a chat

mobile.notifSystem: Show a system notification for new alerts
mobile.followPhoneTheme: Follow the phone's dark theme setting
mobile.pureBlackDesc: Use black backgrounds in dark theme to save power on OLED screens
mobile.splitRoles: Split the channel user list into owners, operators, voiced, users and away
mobile.markdownDesc: Bold, italic, code, spoilers, and links
mobile.scrollDesc: Jump to the first unread message when you return to the app or open a chat
mobile.autoDesc: IRCv3 tags when supported, otherwise inline quote
mobile.linkPreviewsDesc: Show embeds for links in chat

item.incompleteCode: Incomplete code block: transmission was interrupted or dropped by IRC server
item.deleteConfirm: Delete this message for everyone? This cannot be undone.

forward.title: Forward message
forward.desc: Choose the channel to send it to.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.desc: Messages you saved. Only you can see them.
bookmarks.empty: Click the bookmark icon on any message to save it here.

input.uploadDisabled: Uploading is disabled in settings. Enable an upload provider in Settings.
input.disconnectedNoSend: You cannot send messages while disconnected.
input.historyTitle: Position in your sent messages (ArrowUp / ArrowDown)
input.noPermission: You do not have permission to send messages in this moderated channel
input.heading: Heading

header.addDesc: Configure host, port, and nickname to connect to your IRC server.
header.editDesc: Update connection parameters and configuration for your IRC server.

field.name: Server name
field.namePlaceholder: e.g. Local Ergo or Libera Chat
field.autoConnectDesc: Automatically connect to this server when application starts
field.autoReconnectDesc: Automatically attempt to reconnect if connection drops
field.zncTimestampsDesc: Extract timestamps formatted as [HH:MM:SS] from older bouncers without IRCv3 server-time support
field.avatarsDesc: Show avatars of other Luna users on this server and share yours. People without this option ignore it.
field.onConnectCommandsDesc: One per line, run after connecting and before the channels are joined: /msg NickServ IDENTIFY password, /mode MyNick +x, /wait 2 (pause in seconds). Lines starting with ; are ignored. Saved in plain text, like the server password.
field.motdDesc: Configure when to automatically display this server's MOTD on connect or join.
field.displayNameDesc: Select how member names are displayed for this server.
field.imageCollapseDesc: Choose default collapse state for image attachments and previews on this server.
field.replyFormatDesc: Choose how replies are sent to this server. Auto uses modern IRCv3 tags if supported and falls back to legacy inline quoting.

motd.title: Message of the day
motd.none: No message of the day available
motd.noneDesc: The server did not send a MOTD or the MOTD file is empty.
motd.connectingTo: Connecting to {{server}} to retrieve the latest MOTD.

topic.failedPermissions: Failed to update topic due to insufficient permissions.
topic.disabledDesc: Channel topic editing is temporarily disabled while undergoing maintenance and code restructuring.
topic.placeholder: Set a topic for this channel...
topic.locked: Topic is locked (+t): only channel operators can change it.
topic.offline: You are not connected to the server. The topic can only be changed while connected.

update.available: An update for Luna IRC is available. We recommend updating to the latest version.
update.debManual: Packages installed via system installer (.deb) require manual installation from GitHub Releases.

pm.startDesc: Enter the nickname of the user you want to start a private message conversation with.

join.failed: Failed to join channel. Please check the password.

channel.name: Channel name
channel.temporaryDesc: When checked, you will NOT automatically rejoin this channel after restarting the application.

away.title: Already away
away.desc: You are already set to away state.
away.returnHint: Click "Back" to return from away and become active again.

luna.title: Luna features
luna.desc: Features specific to Luna: what Lunas send to each other (none of it shows up in a channel), and extensions.
luna.handshakeDesc: Tells other Lunas that you run Luna (a hidden client tag, not a chat line) and notes who answers. Avatars and reactions only go to Lunas that said hello. Shows "Luna <version>" on a user profile card. Turn off to stay invisible; Luna-only features then stop working.
luna.avatarsDesc: Shows small avatars of Luna users and shares yours. Images are 32x32 (animated GIFs stay animated), travel in short private messages and are stored only on each client. Also enable it per server below.
luna.needsHandshake: Turn on the handshake above, otherwise nobody can find out who is a Luna.
luna.serverAvatarsDesc: Show avatars of Lunas on this server and share yours.
luna.peersDesc: Users who sent a Luna hello this session. Only these are ever sent Luna messages.
luna.noPeers: No other Luna seen yet. They appear when someone with Luna joins or speaks in a channel you are in.
luna.logEmpty: Nothing yet. Handshakes, avatar transfers and reactions appear here.
luna.logNote: Sent (>>) and received (<<) this session. Long lines are cut on screen, Copy keeps them whole.

whois.title: WHOIS: {{nick}}
whois.desc: What the server knows about this user. Only the server sees the request.

extensions.intro: A .js file that adds commands to Luna. It can't see your chats or passwords, and it only reaches the servers you approve when you install it.
extensions.warning: Only install extensions from a source you trust.
extensions.unsupported: Extensions only work in the desktop app.
extensions.trustText:
The extension “{{name}}” connects to {{host}}, but the system does not trust this server's certificate (usually a company's internal certificate authority).

SHA-256 fingerprint:
{{fingerprint}}

Only trust it if this fingerprint matches the one you know. Luna will remember this one certificate and reject any other.
extensions.certDeclined: The certificate of {{host}} was not trusted.
extensions.certMismatch: The certificate of {{host}} differs from the one you trusted. If the change is expected, go to Luna features → Extensions and choose “Forget” for that certificate.

rawLog.title: Raw IRC traffic
rawLog.desc: The last lines sent (>>) and received (<<) on this server. Passwords are hidden.
rawLog.empty: Nothing yet. Lines appear here as the server talks.
rawLog.note: Sent lines: messages, CTCPs, typing and JOINs only.

externalLink.title: Open this link?
externalLink.desc: The link opens outside Luna. Check the address before you continue.
externalLink.suspicious: This address uses a raw IP or look-alike (punycode) characters, which scams often rely on.

mform.zncTimestampsDesc: Read [HH:MM:SS] prefixes from bouncers without server-time
mform.onConnectCommandsDesc: One per line, run before joining channels: /msg NickServ IDENTIFY password, /wait 2. Saved in plain text.
mform.commandsDesc: Map a slash command to chat text. Arguments are appended automatically.

mi.lunaDesc: Handshake, avatars and the log of what Lunas say to each other

ms.syntaxHint: Use quotes for exact phrases, a minus to exclude words, or /regex/.
ms.tryDifferent: Try different words or remove a filter.

rest.chooseFileDrop: Choose a file or drag and drop
rest.headerRulesDesc: Add header rules for private image hosts that require authorization.

rest.leaveChannelDesc: Messages sent to this channel will no longer reach you.
rest.noChannelsDesc: This server currently has no channels. Join an existing channel or create a new one.

ignore.missing: {{mask}} is not on the ignore list.

desc.invite: Invites a user to a channel: /invite <nickname> [#channel]
desc.op: Gives channel operator status to a user: /op [#channel] <nick...>
desc.deop: Removes channel operator status from a user: /deop [#channel] <nick...>
desc.voice: Gives voice status to a user: /voice [#channel] <nick...>
desc.devoice: Removes voice status from a user: /devoice [#channel] <nick...>
desc.code: Sends code wrapped in a code block: /code [code]
desc.motd: Displays the server's Message of the Day (MOTD): /motd
desc.away: Sets away status or displays error if already away: /away [reason]
desc.rawlog: Shows the raw IRC traffic of this server: /rawlog
desc.ignore: Hides messages from a user or mask (without an argument: shows the list): /ignore [nick|nick!user@host]
desc.unignore: Stops ignoring a user or mask: /unignore <nick|nick!user@host>
